title: Satoshi's ParaBox
tagline: A decentralized Storage for Sensitive Data to prevent Bots from reading your Data
description: A decentralized Storage for Sensitive Data such as Medical Data to prevent Bots from reading your Data. The project uses World ID to gate access to data storage and prove humanity. Once Humanity is proven you are taken to a page in which times out after 1 minute unless you extend your time and you can use Walrus Storage, view Analytics and Audit Logs via Hedera Hashgraph and also request a physical representative to assist those who are less tech savvy. when the time on the page runs out the page locks out the person using the site until they once again prove their humanity. Due to the use of Hedera Audits it creates a theoretically HIPAA compliant toolkit. We did use Google's AntiGravity AI to assist in coding this project.
